verdict.rationale: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs is a government company-registry service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it and the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no mention of any MCP server or agent-connection endpoint. The only probes recorded HTTP 403 responses at robots.txt for mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, so nothing beyond those files was fetched and no evidence of the capability exists.
